descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S23 Add / remove / duplicate-prompt logging is recorded with no PHI (Tim's api tests)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Silent, backend-only logging: every patient add tagged Scan or Manual, every patient removed or discharged, and every duplicate prompt as shown, accepted or rejected. … (TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Backend-only (api project)

When Hospital: one manual add, a scan import with a retried request ID, and removals. Nursing Home: one manual add and one scan add. Duplicate prompts shown, accepted and rejected, including retries and impossible outcomes

Then patient_added rows are tagged manual or scan_census per context, and retries do not inflate the counts. Every Hospital removal is logged. Duplicate prompts log shown + outcome, never a name, MRN or diagnosis

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/patient-activity.spec.ts. Not covered by these tests: Nursing Home removal events, a 'discharged' event (Q11), whether the UI really sends the prompt events, and PHI absence on the patient_added / patient_removed rows (these are read back in S11, S12 and S29)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S23

Add / remove / duplicate-prompt logging is recorded with no PHI (Tim's api tests)

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-02.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — Hospital add methods and every removal are recorded — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — Nursing Home manual and resident-list scan adds are distinguished — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — duplicate prompts record shown and the physician outcome — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — duplicate prompt state rejects impossible or conflicting outcomes — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs): the e2e setup makes fresh accounts and seeds with an admin key, which dev does not have.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
